userValue.rationale: The notes describe explicit Astra selection, background dependency workers, restart recovery, and compatibility fixes as observable capabilities. Upgrade guidance identifies executor users who must prepare a fresh plan; limitations explain the required parent review and integration actions.

plainLanguage.rationale: The overview explains the executor as background tasks in separate Git worktrees. Entries use concrete actions and explain inactive conversation behavior. Model/profile identifiers are retained because readers need them to select Astra, while detailed service terminology stays in the linked guide.

publicMigration.rationale: GitHub confirms virusimmortal00/nelos is public. The versioned absolute URL will resolve with the planned v0.14.0 tag to the tracked runbook reviewed here; it also works when these notes become a GitHub Release body. The guide supplies preparation commands, private file permissions, MCP attachment, collection and acceptance steps, and recovery limits. Existing native tasks are explicitly not transferable.

accurateClaims.rationale: Reviewed the release diff from v0.13.0, including Astra catalog and routing, version admission, host-default MCP diagnostics, and executor installation and tools. Background completion, restart collection, and bounded read-only retry claims agree with the runbook and recorded signed-in canaries. The notes preserve unchanged routing defaults and explicitly deny automatic parent resumption, unattended plans, and automatic write retries; they make no Desktop certification claim.

scopeSeparation.rationale: The release section contains user capabilities, affected-user upgrade guidance, and practical limitations. It excludes test counts, CI methodology, hashes, review results, machine identities, and internal implementation inventories; operational detail is linked through the public runbook.
